shared_elements: engraved line-drawn figures on a rock surface
justification: Both surfaces show schematic engraved human figures with arms raised, which is about the only specific correspondence, and even that is a near-universal posture. A depicts a single stick figure beside a long isolated wavy serpentine line and a small cup-mark on an open rock face, whereas B is a densely organised, register-divided stele with rows of seated and standing figures, offering scenes, a winged emblem and columns of sign-like glyphs — utterly different compositional logic and content.
